description.value: Nemo Sushi is a Japanese takeout restaurant in Nanaimo that has built a loyal following for its fresh fish, quality ingredients, and modern takes on classic sushi. Customer reviews highlight it as a hidden gem rivalling higher-end Vancouver sushi spots, with a wide variety of styles including some rare finds. Online ordering and a to-go focus make it a practical and satisfying stop for cyclists passing through Nanaimo.

address.value: 1451 Estevan Rd Unit 4, Nanaimo BC V9S 3Y3
